dataPolicy: Public repository summary only. No user playlist credentials or private Spotify data are bundled into the portfolio.

thoughtProcess.title: Read the Musi playlist source
thoughtProcess.body: Start from a Musi iOS playlist URL whose content is dynamically generated.

thoughtProcess.title: Extract track records
thoughtProcess.body: Scrape and normalize track information so it is usable outside the Musi page.

thoughtProcess.title: Match tracks in Spotify
thoughtProcess.body: Use cleaned song metadata to search or map each Musi entry into Spotify.

thoughtProcess.title: Recreate the playlist
thoughtProcess.body: Automate the transfer so the destination Spotify playlist preserves the original playlist content.
